facility.name: Pinnacle Montessori
facility.programs_provided: School Age Care,Before School Care,Meals Provided ,After School Care,Snacks Provided,Part Time Care,Transportation to/from School ,Field Trips

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Six Inches if Equipment 5 Ft or Less: The loose-fill around the composite play structures in the Primary and Pre-Primary playgrounds were less than six-inches. The platform heights for both structures were both five feet or less.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Six Inches if Equipment 5 Ft or Less (26 TAC §746.4907(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: CPR Training and Recertification Adhere to Guidelines-skill based: Three of ten training records audited did not have CPR training that included hands-on skills based instruction.
occurrences.violation_type_title: CPR Training and Recertification Adhere to Guidelines-skill based (26 TAC §746.1315(b)(1))

occurrences.finding: Garbage Inaccessible to Children; Maintained in Sanitary Manner: A child was observed playing with a fast-food cup containing melted dairy product on the playground. This was corrected at inspection when the trash was removed..
occurrences.violation_type_title: Garbage Inaccessible to Children; Maintained in Sanitary Manner (26 TAC §746.3407(8))

occurrences.finding: Food Service and Preparation Requirement - Safe and Sanitary: A toddler was observed playing in the mulch in the outdoor playground while eating a waffle. This was corrected at inspection when the waffle was thrown away.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Food Service and Preparation Requirement - Safe and Sanitary (26 TAC §746.3317)

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: During the course of the investigation, it was determined that a child was left unsupervised for four minutes.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: The side door of the van used to transport children does not open.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Individual Cot, Bed, or Mat for Each Walking Child Through 4 Years of Age: Two children were sleeping on mats that were torn.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Individual Cot, Bed, or Mat for Each Walking Child Through 4 Years of Age (26 TAC §746.4503(a))

occurrences.finding: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Emergency Medical Information: The operation did not have emergency medical transport and treatment authorization forms for each child being transported.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Emergency Medical Information (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check determination - If ineligible then you must immediately remove subject from operation and confirm to CBCU receipt of notice letter: A caregiver who had direct access to children in care was found by the Centralized Background Check Unit to be ineligible to be present at operation.    Note: This was corrected at inspection when the caregiver was sent home.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check determination - If ineligible then you must immediately remove subject from operation and confirm to CBCU receipt of notice letter (26 TAC §745.635(2))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: Wire fencing was accessible behind a garden area on the playground and the fencing of the garden area was in need of repair due to becoming loose. A play area behind another garden area had two wooden boards on the ground, with exposed screws and a container was also  in the play area containing dried cement with a rod sticking out.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: Based on the DFPS investigation, a two-year-old child cut their finger on a paper cutter that was stored accessible to children in the classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: Based on the DFPS investigation, caregivers were facing away from the children. One caregiver was prepping lunch, and the other caregiver was assisting children in the restroom. Neither caregiver was visually aware of the children in the classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: Based on the DFPS investigation, a caregiver left a classroom to inform the director of an injury that occurred in the classroom, leaving the second caregiver over ratio by three children. Caregiver was left alone with fourteen children with a specified age group of two years.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Medication No Longer Used: Three medications were stored in the first aid cabinet which belonged to children that were no longer enrolled and another medication was stored in a basket that expired on 8/8/25.    Note: This was corrected at inspection when the director removed the medications from storage area to discard.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Medication No Longer Used (26 TAC §746.3809)

occurrences.finding: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current: Three of ten children's records reviewed did not have current immunization records on file at time of review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current (26 TAC §746.613(b))

occurrences.finding: Child-Care Center Must be Equipped with a Working Carbon Monoxide (CO) Detection System: The operation was not equipped with a carbon monoxide detector.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child-Care Center Must be Equipped with a Working Carbon Monoxide (CO) Detection System (26 TAC §746.5531)

occurrences.finding: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean: A section of the ceiling was missing half of a ceiling tile in the Mesquite classroom due to a leaking air conditioner unit. Ceiling tiles were also observed with yellow stains in  the Maple, Willow, Oak, and Mesquite classrooms.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean (26 TAC §746.3407(9))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records- Meets Requirements: Three out of the ten records reviewed did not have education qualification requirements on file at the time of review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records- Meets Requirements (26 TAC §746.901(2))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: Five out of ten records reviewed did not have current immunization records on file at time of review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §746.603(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training- Required Content: Caregivers did not have all of the required training at the time of inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training- Required Content (26 TAC §746.1309(e))

occurrences.finding: Annual Sanitation Inspection: The operation did not have a current sanitation inspection on file at time of review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Sanitation Inspection (26 TAC §746.3401(a))

occurrences.finding: Inspect Fire Extinguishers Monthly: The operation did not have documented that the fire extinguishers had been inspected.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Inspect Fire Extinguishers Monthly (26 TAC §746.5307(a))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: One out of 10 child immunization records reviewed did not have a record on file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §746.603(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Report Change in Director: A director change occurred approximately a month ago and the operation did not notify Child Care Regulation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Change in Director (26 TAC §746.303(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: Two classrooms had a toaster oven on the counter accessible to the children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Orientation: Two out of 10 staff files evaluated did not have a documented orientation completed.  Caregivers hire dates were 5/22/24 and 5/23/24.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Orientation (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(1)(A))

occurrences.finding: Documentation of Drills: A fire drill for May had not been recorded.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documentation of Drills (26 TAC §746.5205(4))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: A child was seen wandering inside the building from the playground.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: A child was left on the playground unsupervised.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months: The operation's annual fire inspection expired on 10/11/2023, upon request, the operation did not have their recent fire inspection form to provide during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Release Information: One of the children records evaluated did not have anyone listed as an authorized pick up personnel.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Release Information (26 TAC §746.605(7))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Date of Admission: One of the children records evaluated did not have the child's admission date to the center.     NOTE: This was corrected at inspection when the child's admission date was added to the record.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Date of Admission (26 TAC §746.605(3))

occurrences.finding: Transportation Safety Training -Director and Employee Complete 2 Hours Annually: The operation did not provide the requested transportation training certificate.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Transportation Safety Training -Director and Employee Complete 2 Hours Annually (26 TAC §746.1316(a))

occurrences.finding: Transportation Safety Training -Director and Employee Complete 2 Hours Annually: A caregiver who drove the van to pick up the afterschool children from school did not have a completed transportation training or certificate.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Transportation Safety Training -Director and Employee Complete 2 Hours Annually (26 TAC §746.1316(a))

occurrences.finding: Report Change in Designee: On 10/2/2023, former director Nancy Gonzales informed me that she is no longer working at the operation. An email was sent to the operation by inspector Natasha Harper, asking the operation if they have found a new director. The operation failed to inform Licensing of their change in Designee and Ms. Gonzales is currently still listed as a Designee.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Change in Designee (26 TAC §746.303(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Transportation Safety Training -Director and Employee Complete 2 Hours Annually: A caregiver who drove the van to pick up the afterschool children from school did not have a completed transportation training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Transportation Safety Training -Director and Employee Complete 2 Hours Annually (26 TAC §746.1316(a))

occurrences.finding: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean: The vent in the nap room bathroom was covered with dust.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean (26 TAC §746.3407(9))

occurrences.finding: Report Outbreak of Communicable Illness: Based on information gathered the operation reported a positive covid case a day late.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Outbreak of Communicable Illness (26 TAC §746.305(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Complying with Laws and Rules: The operation's permit holder did not respond to multiple attempts by director requesting the repair of missing/damaged ceiling tiles in multiple classrooms.     The operation came into compliance when they provided photos of the repaired ceiling tiles.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Complying with Laws and Rules (26 TAC §746.201(9))

occurrences.finding: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean: The operation had damaged ceiling tiles in multiple classrooms.     The operation came into compliance when photos of the repaired ceiling tiles were sent via email.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean (26 TAC §746.3407(9))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Supervision of Children: Based on interviews conducted, two caregivers failed to supervise a child in their care during transition and as a result, an 18-month child walked away and entered a vacant classroom without the knowledge of the caregivers. The child was left unattended for four minutes.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Supervision of Children (26 TAC §746.1203(4))

occurrences.finding: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Six Inches if Equipment 5 Ft or Less: Pre-primary playground was missing the required depth of loose fill within their use zones.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Six Inches if Equipment 5 Ft or Less (26 TAC §746.4907(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months: A Fire inspection was not available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))

occurrences.finding: Emergency Preparedness Plan - Evacuation, relocation, and sheltering/lock-down procedures: An emergency preparedness plan was not accessible for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Emergency Preparedness Plan - Evacuation, relocation, and sheltering/lock-down procedures (26 TAC §746.5202(1))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity: Operation policies were missing the time durations, and benefits, of how the operation will be promoting indoor and outdoor physical activity.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity (26 TAC §746.501(a)(18))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and directors - Pediatric CPR: One out of ten staff files had an expired CPR and First Aid training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and directors - Pediatric CPR (26 TAC §746.1301(4)(A))

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days: Five feeding instruction forms were noted not up to date.  Note: Forms were dated 5/6/2022.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days (26 TAC §746.2421(b))

occurrences.finding: Discipline - Positive Methods of Discipline and Guidance: A caregiver redirected an infant on two separate occasions by pulling the infant's arm and leg, causing the child to hit his face during one of the interactions.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Discipline - Positive Methods of Discipline and Guidance (26 TAC §746.2803(4))

occurrences.finding: Basic Requirements for Infants - Holding and Comforting: An infant caregiver was not attending to crying infants. Infants were allowed to cry for approximately 25-30 minutes without being comforted.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Basic Requirements for Infants - Holding and Comforting (26 TAC §746.2401(3))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: An infant caregiver failed to use good judgment when she moved an infant by using her feet to reposition him.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: Classroom Mesquite is currently being used for storage and not maintained as licensed space.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Proper Depth Maintained: The loose-fill around the all fall zones in both playgrounds did not have the required depth. The loose fill was less than 1 inch in some areas.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Proper Depth Maintained (26 TAC §746.4907(d))

occurrences.finding: Basic Requirements for Infants - Free from Choking Objects That May Cause Choking in Infants or Toddlers: There were two bead strings found in the infant classroom (0-12months). One string was on a child and the other was found inside an infant crib.   Note: Caregivers removed immediately.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Basic Requirements for Infants - Free from Choking Objects That May Cause Choking in Infants or Toddlers (26 TAC §746.2401(6))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know Group Responsible For: Two caregivers were negligent in accounting for their children responsible while in their care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know Group Responsible For (26 TAC §746.1203(2))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Free of other activities: Based on the evidence provided a caregiver was noted utilizing a cell phone while caring for children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Free of other activities (26 TAC §746.1203(6))

occurrences.finding: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk: The operation failed to report to Licensing on negligent supervision.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk (26 TAC §746.305(a)(6))

occurrences.finding: Parental Communication - Notify Parent Immediately of Administration of an unassigned Epinephrine Auto-injector: The operation did not notify parents in a timely manner of the incidents regarding supervision.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Parental Communication - Notify Parent Immediately of Administration of an unassigned Epinephrine Auto-injector (26 TAC §746.307(b)(3))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers- Supervision of Children: Based on interviews conducted, two caregivers in two different incidents failed to supervise a child age 4 and child age 2 years old, by not ensuring all children were accounted for resulting in the children being left behind.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Supervision of Children (26 TAC §746.1203(4))

occurrences.finding: Licensing Incident/Illness Report Form - Communicable Diseases: An incident report was not available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Licensing Incident/Illness Report Form - Communicable Diseases (26 TAC §746.701(4))

occurrences.finding: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk: The operation failed to make a report to Child Care Regulation within 48 hours regarding children who were placed at risk while in their care due to a lack of supervision.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk (26 TAC §746.305(a)(6))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: Two employees present during the investigation were found missing background checks. Individuals did not have an eligibility status and were present in the operation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Parental Communication - Notify Parent Immediately of Administration of an unassigned Epinephrine Auto-injector: The operation did not notify parents in a timely manner of the incidents regarding supervision.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Parental Communication - Notify Parent Immediately of Administration of an unassigned Epinephrine Auto-injector (26 TAC §746.307(b)(3))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers- Supervision of Children: Based on interviews conducted, two caregivers failed to supervise children in their classroom as a result of two children 2 years of age walking out of the classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Supervision of Children (26 TAC §746.1203(4))

occurrences.finding: Licensing Incident/Illness Report Form - Communicable Diseases: An incident report was not available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Licensing Incident/Illness Report Form - Communicable Diseases (26 TAC §746.701(4))

occurrences.finding: Report Number of Employees: A review of Employees Who left Employment in 2021 data from February 23, 2022, revealed that the center had not reported the number of employees who left employment in 2021 by February 22, 2022, as required.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Number of Employees (26 TAC §746.303(b))
